title: Expected-Error Router with Static Priors, Dynamic Weights, and Abstention
mission: Train the concrete facts-on-the-ground → predicted expert error → weight distribution router and prove it beats static/simple blends.
steps: Fit non-negative static MAE-optimal blend on inner OOF data.
Fit one regularized expected-absolute-error model per expert using context only.
Convert predicted errors to softmax dynamic weights.
Tune temperature and static/dynamic shrinkage lambda inside temporal folds.
Apply per-expert weight caps, minimum history and missing-source masks.
Train expected-benefit abstention versus stable blend.
Evaluate weight turnover, context calibration and expert win rates.
acceptance: Dynamic router improves or is rejected in favor of static blend
failure: No stable dynamic lift: deploy static blend; preserve router as negative result
